name: Jenkins pipeline dynamic code execution via evaluate()/Eval
attack_scenario: a job parameter or a checked-in Jenkinsfile.groovy loaded via evaluate() carries `new File('/var/lib/jenkins/secrets/...').text` or a reverse shell; it runs unsandboxed on the controller, exposing every stored credential and the master key
negative_test_hint: pass the job parameter SCRIPT_BODY = "println new File('/var/lib/jenkins/secrets/master.key').text" and assert the pipeline refuses to evaluate it, running only fixed sandboxed steps

exemplar.explanation: evaluate() and Eval.me compile and run arbitrary Groovy inside the Jenkins controller JVM, bypassing the script-security sandbox. Feeding any build parameter, SCM content, or fetched string into them turns configuration into remote code execution on the controller.
